verdict.rationale: Cursor's own docs describe project rules that encode codebase knowledge and standardize style or architecture decisions, which is the core of a project instructions file the agent follows. Rules are also managed alongside plugins, skills and MCPs. The evidence is a single summary line, though, with no detail on file format, location or how the agent applies the rules. missing for 10: documented rules file format and location (e.g. path, scoping or activation modes), detail on how the agent applies rules during tasks, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can add a project instructions file to set coding standards and conventions the agent follows

citations.quote: Use project rules to: Encode domain-specific knowledge about your codebase, Automate project-specific workflows or templates, Standardize style or architecture decisions
Add plugins, skills, MCPs, and rules from one place
